verdict.rationale: A public CVE or security-advisory history is a fair question to ask of any open-source UI framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions a security policy, GitHub security advisories, CVEs, or how Solid discloses vulnerabilities. The GitHub items cover features, and the community items cover developer experience and the wider ecosystem.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review the project's public CVE/security-advisory history to judge its track record of handling and disclosing vulnerabilities
